Maximilian Rohr (Elversberg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Cole Campbell (Elversberg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Ibrahim Maza (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Jarell Quansah replaces Loïc Badé.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Facundo Medina replaces Equi Fernández.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Christian Kofane replaces Lucas Vázquez.
Substitution, Elversberg. Noah Darvich replaces Francis Onyeka.
Substitution, Elversberg. Maurice Krattenmacher replaces Cole Campbell.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Jonas Hofmann replaces Malik Tillman.
Delay in match because of an injury Lukas Pinckert (Elversberg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Elversberg. Luca Schnellbacher replaces David Mokwa.
